Mobility Program | AIC T-Hub Future of Transportation About Focus Areas Benefits Criteria Program Structure Timeline FAQ's AIC T-Hub Mobility Program Revolutionising the mobility space, one mile at a time. Express Interest About the Program Charge, an initiative by AIC T-Hub Foundation, supported by Atal Innovation Mission, NITI Aayog, is a dedicated program designed to cultivate a robust Mobility ecosystem in India. The program focuses on promoting cutting-edge research, pioneering solutions, and strengthening the Mobility supply chain to fuel industry growth and innovation. With a strong emphasis on global collaboration, Charge is committed to accelerating Mobility startups, guiding them from early-stage to successful commercialisation. The program offers tailored mentorship from industry experts, access to various funding opportunities, and extensive networking support. By empowering startups with the necessary tools and connections, Charge helps them refine their commercialisation strategies, expand market reach, and engage with key stakeholders in the Mobility sector. Sustainability Program | AIC T-Hub Green Innovation About Benefits Focus Area Criteria Program Schedule Program Timeline FAQ's AIC T-Hub Sustainability Program Igniting sustainable innovation for a greener tomorrow Express Interest About the Program Apply Now The AIC T-Hub Sustainability Accelerator – Cohort 4 is a 15-week hybrid program designed to support startups with a ready PoC or beyond, developing high-impact sustainability solutions. The program focuses on sectors including climate tech, ocean tech, AgriTech, renewable energy, circular economy, sustainable manufacturing, green infrastructure, and more. ‍ The program offers a unique blend of expert mentorship, hands-on workshops, market access, funding opportunities, and post-program support, helping founders navigate real-world challenges in deploying sustainability tech at scale. Hosted by AIC T-Hub Foundation, supported by Atal Innovation Mission, NITI Aayog, and powered by T-Hub – the world’s largest home for startups, this cohort is curated to help mission-driven founders promote their growth in terms of scaling their solutions into the market. Program Benefits Customized milestone-based growth plan Each startup receives a personalized roadmap that is aligned with its product, market, and funding goals Weekly 1:1 mentorship sessions Dedicated expert support to resolve real-time product, GTM, or scale-up challenges.
